'''Thila''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Thila system/Legends|Thila system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was home to a major [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base, [[Thila Command]]. The planet had relatively huge mountain ranges, of which the peaks of its gigantic mountains were visible from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].

==History==
[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] interviewed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on Thila shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

[[File:Thila.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Imperial troops landing on Thila.]]

Approximately eight months after the Battle of Yavin, Imperial forces under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kale Roshuir]] investigated a lead of possible Rebel activity on the planet, and discovered an underground base in the mountains on the planet. Upon [[Ambush at Thila|entering]] the abandoned facility, however, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] triggered a booby trap which killed many of the Imperial troops, although Roshuir himself survived the incident.<ref name="TWSotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Thila in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]].
